race.comment: BELIEVE AGAIN (10) ran on nicely from well back when finishing fifth as the favourite at Belmont 11 days ago. Stepping up to the mile is the key here, and in a field that is not strong, he is the one to beat. Follow your money. JUST YES (2) finished ahead of the top pick in the same race when resuming from a spell, and was only a neck from the winner in second place. He too has a big finish, and should make the quinella. THREESPIRIT (8) was better last start at Pinjarra, and he will relish stepping up to 1600m for the first time. Holly Nottle who rode him on debut in a good performance is back in the saddle, and the pair can figure in the top 4 this time. PURE 'N' SIMPLE (7) got too far back from a wide gate last time out, and she can improve quickly from a superior gate this time. A 3kg claim will also help, and she is worth including in all combos. DAISIESFORTHELADYS (5) drops back to 1600m from 2200m, and is drawn to receive a cosy run early on. Keep her safe.
